about: A tool that watches torrent and usenet feeds and grabs releases that match your filters.

prs.title: Freeleech filters check every range in the list
prs.broken: A freeleech filter with more than one range only looked at the first. If that one did not match, the release was rejected, even when a later range matched.
prs.changed: Every range in the list is now checked before the release is turned down.
prs.matters: Filters grab the releases people set them up to grab, instead of quietly missing them.
